title: Union of India v. Hindustan Development Corporation

content.caseIdentity: Union of India v. Hindustan Development Corporation, (1993) 3 SCC 499
content.facts: Railway suppliers challenged government procurement decisions and invoked legitimate expectation.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the nature and limit of legitimate expectation in public law?
content.ratioDecidendi: Legitimate expectation may arise from representation, promise or consistent past practice, but it does not automatically create a substantive enforceable right and remains subject to public interest and lawful policy.
content.holding: The Court clarified the doctrine's scope and limits.
content.relevance: Use as the principal Indian authority for the doctrine.
